name: STOP-BANG
shortDescription: 8-item clinical screener for obstructive sleep apnea risk — pairs directly with the Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS).
timeframe: Answer Yes or No to each of the 8 STOP-BANG sleep apnea risk questions:
citation: Chung F, Yegneswaran B, Liao P, et al. Anesthesiology. 2008;108(5):812-821; Chung F, Abdullah HR, Liao P. Chest. 2016;149(3):631-638.

questions.text: Snoring: Do you snore loudly (loud enough to be heard through closed doors, or your bed partner elbows you for snoring at night)?
Tired: Do you often feel tired, fatigued, or sleepy during the daytime (such as falling asleep during driving or talking to someone)?
Observed: Has anyone observed you stop breathing or choking/gasping during your sleep?
Pressure: Do you have or are you being treated for high blood pressure?
BMI: Is your Body Mass Index (BMI) more than 35 kg/m²?
Age: Are you older than 50 years old?
Neck size: Is your neck circumference greater than 16 inches (40 cm)?
Gender: Is your biological sex male?

scoring.formulaDescription: Count of 'Yes' answers across all 8 items (range 0–8). Standard OSA risk tiers: 0–2 Low Risk, 3–4 Intermediate Risk, 5–8 High Risk. Per Chung et al. (2016), scoring ≥2 on the 4 STOP questions plus male sex, BMI >35, or neck >40 cm also elevates risk to High.
